data.long_meaning: Mifzal is an Arabic name derived from the word 'afzal', meaning 'a fortress' or 'a stronghold'. In Islamic context, it is believed that the name symbolizes protection and strength. It is also mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Hashr, where it refers to a fortified city. The name Mifzal carries the meaning “A fortress, a stronghold” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mifzal usually hope their child will grow to embody a fortress, a stronghold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
